lines.en: I hang beneath the leaf, swaying slowly.

lines.zh: 橙色在叶荫里像一小块光
lines.en: Orange in the leaf shade, like a small patch of light.
The thread is fine and has never broken.
The wind comes; I swing higher.

lines.zh: 我碰到旁边的叶子，弹回来
lines.en: I touch a neighboring leaf and rebound.
The whole twig is moving.
I sway with it, not resisting.
There is a small gleam on the shell.
I hang lower than my companions.

lines.zh: 雨斜着打过来，我转过去
lines.en: Slanted rain; I turn away from it.
I drift back into place.
The swinging makes me faintly dizzy.
Head down, I sway slowly.
An orange edge shows past the leaf.
I rise and fall with the whole twig.
A drop hangs below me.

lines.zh: 橙色看起来像枯叶的边
lines.en: The orange resembles a withered leaf edge.
I try to be quiet.
The shell wraps me tightly.
The light spots below are shifting.
The change inside goes on.

lines.zh: 蛹壳里我只需要慢慢长。
lines.en: Inside my shell, all I need is to grow slowly.
I hear insects.
The moss on the branch is thick.

lines.zh: 我选了这个背风的角落
lines.en: I chose this sheltered corner.

lines.zh: 叶子替我挡了大半的雨
lines.en: The leaf blocks most of the rain.
Waiting does not feel long.

lines.zh: 我借着风，把蛹身转了个向。
lines.en: The breeze turns my hanging body a little.

lines.zh: 我挂在离你不远的地方
lines.en: I hang not far from you.
Orange stands out more than leaf.
You have stopped under the tree.
I wonder what you are looking for.
My shell is opaque.
You are looking at the wrong angle.

lines.zh: 我晃了一下，引起你注意
lines.en: I sway once to catch your eye.
You took me for a leaf.
I have been here a long while.
Do not take me for a bug.
A small break in the shell.
I spin a long while before stopping.
A patch of orange goes dark.
The thread swings wildly.

lines.zh: 橙色蛹壳疼得我往里缩。
lines.en: The orange shell hurts so much that I curl inward.
I do not know how much longer I can hold.
This shell is too thin.
I hang there, slowly.
I try not to move.
Please do not touch again.
I have no mouth to use right now.
That does not suit me.
You hold the flower too close.
I smell the sweetness and cannot eat.
In a few more days.
I accept no gifts.
Your arm will ache holding that.
I have no use for that.
Stick it in the soil.
I have noted the kindness.
I swing into the stem.
Your hat touched me.
The thread is pulled askew.
I spin before settling.
The leaf is pressed over.
I see the ground turn twice.
A small dent in the shell.
Do not push upward.
I press to the vein.
That nearly worked me loose.
I am not at that stage yet.

lines.zh: 这颜色将来会派上用场
lines.en: This color will serve its purpose later.
For now, only waiting.
There are not many of my kind here.
I hang on the lowest branch.
We will speak of that later.
There is only me in this shell.

lines.zh: 羽化之前，我没心思谈这个。
lines.en: Until I emerge, I have no mind for such things.
The wind got here before me.
Wait until the light is warmer.

lines.zh: 我挂在叶上，什么都够不到。
lines.en: I hang from a leaf and can reach nothing.
It hangs on the twig below me.

lines.zh: 我没有可以抓握的地方
lines.en: I have nothing to grip with.

lines.zh: 我挂在叶上，拿不了那东西。
lines.en: I am hanging from a leaf; I cannot hold that.
The wind took it away.
I saw it, but I cannot move.
This does not belong to me.
Leave it where it is.
The leaf moves and so do I.
Someone below will pick it up.
You are still under the tree.
An orange shell cannot hide.

lines.zh: 我挂在叶上，一动不能动。
lines.en: Hung on a leaf, unable to move.
My thread is fastened well.
You cannot shake this twig.
I hang above your reach.

lines.zh: 我隔着橙壳，静静盯着你。
lines.en: Through my orange shell, I watch you quietly.
I will be easy once you go.
Do not poke at me.

lines.zh: 这片叶子上还挂着别的蛹。
lines.en: Other chrysalises hang from this very leaf.
I watch you through the leaf gap.
You circled half way round.
I turn with the wind.
Every sway changes the angle.
Your neck will tire.
I have not moved in so long.

lines.zh: 绿色的背景帮我藏住一半
lines.en: The green background hides half of me.
The leaves above are thick.
I watch your shadow.
Sooner or later you will go.
Hanging by a thread, I cannot attack.
Touch me and the leaf tears.
My shell is hard and will pinch.
I slipped off the leaf.
Water from the leaf tip falls in your eye.
I cannot even turn away.
That was your own doing.
I have fallen at your feet.
A crack has opened.
No more of that.
A caterpillar chose this leaf.
The orange shows through for the first time.
I hang on a low branch.
Leaves everywhere in this jungle.
First I fasten myself.
Mud below.
Wind comes through the forest.
My shell is still a little soft.
The light catches this patch just right.

lines.zh: 我在丛林叶背听见了溪水声。
lines.en: From under a jungle leaf I hear a stream running far off.
Heat nears and the leaf scorches first.
I part from the thread and drop.
Water fills the whole shell.
The blast flings the twig up.
Something pierces the leaf and grazes the shell.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我在里面翻动
lines.en: That force turns me over inside.

lines.zh: 挂着的时候不必吃东西
lines.en: While hanging, no need to eat.
Lightning hits the tree and I jerk.
Leaf and thread are both gone.
